resources.string: Opens apps for the remote\'s app and gear buttons. It reads the TV\'s key log and filters no keys, so a held volume key keeps repeating.
✗ Off: run install.sh again, or turn on Remote buttons in Settings › Accessibility
✗ Cannot read the key log: run install.sh (it grants READ_LOGS over ADB)
Buttons (the built-in Hisense map). Select one to remove it:
Your buttons. Select one to remove it:
Press the remote button that should open %1$s.\n\nThe arrows, OK, Back, Home, volume and power keep their normal job and are not taken.
Remote buttons is not ready yet: it needs to be on and able to read the key log. Run install.sh again from a computer.
No button press arrived.\n\nIf you pressed one, this TV does not report button presses in its log, so Remote buttons cannot work on it.

Another screen opened while waiting for the button, so that button already does something on this TV.\n\nNothing was assigned. Pick a button the TV leaves unused, or change that button in the TV\'s own settings.

Button %1$d already does something on this TV: it just opened another screen.\n\nIt was not assigned, so it keeps only its own job. Pick a button the TV leaves unused, or change that button in the TV\'s own settings.
Forget your buttons and go back to the built-in Hisense map?
